_comment: Copy this file to settings.json and edit it. settings.json is gitignored.
Two passes, configured separately because they are routinely different: a
studio may run every text pass through a CLI it already licenses and have
to send image work somewhere else. 'vision' is the only one that gets
images; 'text' does the interpreting and matching.
Three kinds of backend. Set 'kind' to one of them and fill in the fields
it uses; the others are ignored.
command  Runs a CLI you already have. The prompt goes in on stdin, or
in place of {prompt} if you put it in the arguments. Use
{images} for one argument per frame, or --flag={image} to
repeat a flag per frame.
api      Posts to an HTTP endpoint. 'api_key_env' is the NAME of an
environment variable holding your key — never the key itself,
so this file is safe to copy between machines.
'api_style' is anthropic, openai or ollama.
local    A model runtime on this machine. No key, nothing leaves the
building, but it needs hardware. Optional: the command and api
paths are the supported ones.
The examples below are commented out by being under '_examples'. Move the
one you want up into 'vision' or 'text'.
